name: Snakehead with ant eggs
nameVi: Cá lóc canh chua trứng kiến
summary: A sour soup of snakehead fish with ant eggs.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 23 May 2023 names cá lóc nấu canh chua cùng trứng kiến in the meal visitors miss.
howToEat: It comes in a forest meal with stir-fried greens, bitter-eggplant soup, and bamboo rice dipped in sesame salt.
where: Stilt-house meals in Buon Don, Lak, and Buon Ma Thuot.
seoTitle: Ca loc trung kien — snakehead and ant eggs
seoDescription: Snakehead sour soup with ant eggs, part of a forest meal in Buon Don, Lak, and Buon Ma Thuot.
